propositions: The snapshot-entry schema is currently a hand-rolled Python module outside the centralized schema machinery, causing it to be unenforced while 90 sibling schemas are automatically validated
fetcher.py never imports _snapshot_schema.py, breaking the intended producer-schema contract despite being declared as file impact in the originating story
The snapshot schema encodes a parent field whose presence/absence gates an inbound CLEAR operation that destroys data, yet lacks automated drift detection
Real fetcher output exists in bridge_state/snapshots/ (548 files, 2026-06-11..06-29) covering all three shapes but is gitignored and contains PII, requiring a redacted fixture
Moving the snapshot contract into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrating it with the existing generated-types CI gate will enforce schema compliance automatically
